note: Curated adaptations of topic titles, not verified claims or measured performance scores. All candidates need fresh primary-source research. Anonymous prototype characters are not assigned fictional-family facts.

ideas.question: Why can a dividend feel cheaper than a salary?
ideas.project_fit: Closest continuation: same characters and existing connected-effects work.
ideas.research_needed: Keep company cost equal and include payroll costs when comparing cash.

ideas.source_title: Keep it in the company or pay it out
ideas.question: What changes when money stays inside your company?
ideas.project_fit: Reuse the company/owner relationship while distinguishing access and timing.
ideas.research_needed: Separate deferral from permanent savings and identify the income type.

ideas.question: Why is a capital dividend account not a bank account?
ideas.project_fit: A strong example of a record that changes permission without adding cash.
ideas.research_needed: Verify the account calculation, payment conditions and elections.

ideas.question: How can investment income affect a company’s small-business limit?
ideas.project_fit: Connected effects across income types and a future business limit.
ideas.research_needed: Verify thresholds, associated-company scope and the relevant years.

ideas.question: What does an estate freeze actually freeze?
ideas.project_fit: A temporal story about current value and future growth.
ideas.research_needed: Distinguish share value, future growth, control and tax timing.

ideas.source_title: Double tax on private company shares at death
ideas.question: How can one company create two layers of tax at death?
ideas.project_fit: Multiple parties and times suit a coherent evolving scene.
ideas.research_needed: Do not prescribe a pipeline; source available relief and its conditions.

ideas.source_title: Terminal return and tax at death
ideas.question: What can trigger tax when someone dies without selling anything?
ideas.project_fit: A visual change of ownership can expose a deemed transaction.
ideas.research_needed: Separate deemed disposition, estate cash and provincial administration costs.

ideas.source_title: Company-owned insurance and the CDA route to the family
ideas.question: What changes when a company owns the life-insurance policy?
ideas.project_fit: Ownership, beneficiary, cash and account records can be shown separately.
ideas.research_needed: Verify policy ownership, adjusted cost basis and the account credit.

ideas.source_title: TOSI check per recipient per year
ideas.question: Why is paying a family member not one simple tax calculation?
ideas.project_fit: Conditional reasoning can be shown without inventing a final verdict.
ideas.research_needed: Verify the recipient-specific exclusions and facts before drawing a conclusion.

ideas.source_title: CPP/QPP start age for the couple
ideas.question: What changes when you start CPP earlier or later?
ideas.project_fit: Show time, income and uncertainty without implying a personal savings pot.
ideas.research_needed: Distinguish CPP and QPP and define the comparison and longevity assumptions.

ideas.question: Why can the order of retirement withdrawals matter?
ideas.project_fit: One withdrawal can have immediate and later effects.
ideas.research_needed: Use a multi-year comparison, not a single-year tax-rate shortcut.

ideas.source_title: OAS start age and the recovery tax, year by year
ideas.question: What connects a withdrawal today to OAS recovery tax?
ideas.project_fit: Connect income, timing and a later benefit adjustment.
ideas.research_needed: Source the income basis, relevant periods, thresholds and household assumptions.

ideas.source_title: Alter ego or joint partner trust compared with a will
ideas.question: What changes with an alter ego or joint partner trust?
ideas.project_fit: Separate legal ownership, tax timing and estate administration.
ideas.research_needed: Do not imply all tax disappears or treat different provinces as equivalent.

ideas.source_title: US estate tax exposure per decedent
ideas.question: Why might a Canadian estate need to consider US estate tax?
ideas.project_fit: Use ownership and jurisdiction to reveal a less visible connection.
ideas.research_needed: Verify situs, residence, citizenship, treaty relief and filing obligations.

ideas.source_title: Gifts of listed securities in kind: lot selection
ideas.question: Why can giving securities differ from selling them and giving cash?
ideas.project_fit: Follow one asset through two routes to the same charitable purpose.
ideas.research_needed: Verify the recipient, gain treatment, donation credit and AMT assumptions.

ideas.source_title: Principal residence designation ledger and optimiser
ideas.question: Why can one family not claim every home the same way?
ideas.project_fit: Show how a choice about one property affects the others.
ideas.research_needed: Source family-unit, eligibility and designation rules; avoid an automatic verdict.
